title: MAHARASHTRA CLASS 11 — English | Subject Verb Agreement
description: Subject-wise test on Subject Verb Agreement (English) for MAHARASHTRA CLASS 11. 40Q.
subject: maha11-english

questions.question: The manager, along with his team members, ______ attending the conference.

options.explanation: Incorrect because 'The manager' is singular.
Correct because 'The manager' is singular.
Incorrect because 'The manager' is singular.
Incorrect because 'The manager' is singular.

questions.explanation: When a singular subject (The manager) is followed by a phrase like 'along with', 'as well as', 'in addition to', etc., the verb agrees with the main subject.
questions.hint: Identify the main subject and check if it is singular or plural.

Incorrect because 'Neither' is singular.

questions.explanation: Indefinite pronouns like 'neither', 'each', 'every', 'one', 'anyone', 'everyone', 'someone', 'no one', 'nobody' always take a singular verb.

questions.question: Which option correctly transforms the following sentence into the passive voice? 'The committee will announce the results tomorrow.'

options.text: The results are announced by the committee tomorrow.

options.explanation: This uses the past simple passive, which is incorrect for future tense.

options.text: The results will have been announced by the committee tomorrow.
